Format: 51 .ogg files in Audio/ (click1-5, mouseclick1, mouserelease1,
  rollover1-6, switch1-38)
Covers: menu/dialog blips -- click/rollover for menu navigation, switch sounds
  for confirm/cancel/page-advance in the dialog box (the typewriter "line done"
  moment) and the pause menu.
Does not cover: footsteps/world SFX (see kenney-rpg-audio) or music.
